welcome.heading: Write your thesis, offline.
welcome.description: Create a new project, or open an existing .marktwain file.

workspace.empty: Select a document to start writing.

document.titleHint: Leave empty to use the default title.
document.deleteBody: “{{title}}” and its content will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
document.dragSameKind: Documents can only be moved among documents of the same kind.

search.title: Search the project
search.description: Find text in every document of the project.
search.truncated: Only the first matches are shown, narrow the search to see the others.

newProject.title: About your thesis
newProject.description: This fills the cover and the title page. You can skip it and change everything later in the settings.
newProject.filled: Filled in from your earlier project.
newProject.more: More details, English title and keywords
newProject.problem: Some of the answers cannot be used, check the fields that are marked.

engine.title: How should the thesis be typeset?
engine.description: Each project is typeset in one way. Most people can pick Typst.

typst.name: Typst
typst.note: Recommended. Built in, nothing to install, and the preview is quick.

latex.name: LaTeX
latex.note: Only if your advisor or department already has a LaTeX template. It uses the TeX Live of this computer, and builds are slower than Typst.

missing.tex: No TeX Live was found on this computer. Install TeX Live or TinyTeX first, then start again.
missing.citation-style-language: The TeX Live of this computer lacks the package citation-style-language, install it with tlmgr, then start again.
missing.template: The LaTeX template is missing from this copy of MarkTwain. Reinstall MarkTwain.

word.name: Word
word.note: Not available yet, it comes in a later version. For now you can export a PDF for your advisor.

engine.warning: This cannot be changed after the project is created, because the files of the two ways are different. To use the other one, start a new project.
